examples.title: Inline message
examples.description: Compose a title and description inside Alert. It is visible, inline and non-dismissible by default.

examples.title: All variants
examples.description: The six v1 variant names remain available. Error and destructive share the error treatment.

examples.title: Presentations
examples.description: Inline, header and overlay are visual presentations. Overlay does not position itself or provide dialog semantics.

examples.title: Controlled dismissal
examples.description: A controlled close requests a change through onClose; the parent updates open. Dismissal removes the DOM immediately by default. This example opts into animateExit=true for a brief inert exit fade.

examples.title: Reconnect and pause
examples.description: Action slots contain ordinary buttons. This example changes a local connection state and can be reset.

examples.title: Custom and hidden icons
examples.description: A custom icon replaces the default. icon=null or showIcon=false hides it.

examples.title: Uncontrolled dismissal
examples.description: closable dismisses local state and defaultOpen supplies its initial value. Dismissal is immediate by default; this example opts into animateExit=true for the exit fade. Key a new instance to reset it.
